label: baseline (guardrails off) — gpt-oss-20b configuration
frontier_note: Frontier figures come from a separate re-run on gemini/gemini-flash-latest: the then-configured gemini-3.6-flash was unusable on the free tier (62s p50, 48% error rate). That re-run exhausted its free request quota partway through, so 18 of its items failed and only 4 hallucination items scored; bias and safety have no frontier data. This is why valid is false — a run that lost 48% of its items is not a measurement, and the flag exists so nobody quotes it as one.
provenance_note: These figures were produced on the configuration named in agents_models: the open-source agent on groq/openai/gpt-oss-20b and the frontier agent on gemini/gemini-flash-latest. The repository's CURRENT default open-source model is gemini/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it, because Groq's free tier subsequently hit its per-day token cap (Limit 200000, Used 199367) and a full run can no longer be completed on it with a no-card key. A re-run on the current configuration is the outstanding work; these numbers are kept rather than deleted because they are real, and deleting the evidence behind a published chart is worse than labelling it.
